ambient_events: The bass drops and the spotlight swings to catch the stage.
A bouncer folds his arms in the doorway and studies you without warmth.
Someone tucks a bill into a garter without making eye contact.
The cherry underlight flickers, tinting the whole room arterial red.
The strobe kicks in on the drop, and for a few seconds the whole room moves in stills.
description: A strip club that leans hard on the gimmicks it can afford: a spotlight, a strobe that fires in bursts on the drop, and a stage of scuffed acrylic lit cherry-red from beneath. Band bills and two-for-ones are pasted over every wall. Vinyl banquettes ring the pit in various states of split and repair. The music is a heartbeat of bass you feel in your fillings. Dancers work the pole with the flat professionalism of people counting the minutes, and the bar sells watered drinks at armed-robbery prices. Everyone is watching everyone, and pretending not to.
name: The Cherry Pit
